qualification.en: The line calls for transparency, choice, competition and new affordable options. It names no kind of plan and does not say whether coverage should come through a public plan or private plans. It is shown and not scored.

quote: Healthcare and prescription drug costs are out of control. Republicans will increase Transparency, promote Choice and Competition, and expand access to new Affordable Healthcare and prescription drug options.

sourceTitle.en: 2024 Republican Party Platform, “Make America Great Again!” (PDF, undated; adopted by the RNC Platform Committee July 8, 2024, per the GOP press release of that date), p. 15

summary.en: The platform says Republicans will increase transparency, promote choice and competition, and expand access to new affordable health care and prescription drug options.
